beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part three. Surface: blur-in where the mark arrives out of focus and sharpens, color interpolation ink to terracotta and back, a kinetic grid tiling the H across the frame on staggered delay, and glitch slices that offset and snap clean. The mark holds position; the surface carries the energy.

Let's recap with Claude. Blur arrival: out of focus, sharpens. Color: ink to terracotta and back — the one color beat in this set. Kinetic grid: H tiled, staggered ripple. Glitch: horizontal slices offset for eight frames then snap clean. The snap is why the glitch works. Without the clean resolution it's just noise.

Your turn. Paste this: tile the H logo across the full frame in a kinetic grid, then add a glitch-slice offset to every copy — and tell me at what grid size it reads as wallpaper versus as system. That line is a brand decision.
H logo, in motion. Part three. Liam, in for Bear.
